meta.name: success-metrics-evaluation
meta.description: Evaluate delivery outcomes against defined success metrics and acceptance goals. Activate after Delivery to verify that delivered work creates real business and technical impact, not just output.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证交付物是否达成业务与技术指标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果交付后需要确认成果是否带来预期影响。
copy.tagline_en: Verify delivered outcomes against defined success metrics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to confirm that delivered work creates real impact.

howto.what: 评估交付成果是否达成定义的成功指标（如 PRD 或 Story 中的指标），生成逐故事 KPI 报告、指标对比、差距分析和改进建议。
howto.when: 当交付完成且运行时数据可用，且 PRD 或 Story 中已定义成功指标时触发。

say.text: 评估新交付的用户故事是否达到性能目标。
say.note: 生成 KPI 报告和差距分析。

say.text: 检查本次交付的成功指标达成情况。
say.note: 对比实际 vs 目标，给出改进建议。

say.text: 分析这个功能的运行时数据是否满足预期。
say.note: 识别未达标之处及根因。

howto.what_en: After delivery, evaluates outcomes against defined success metrics (e.g., from PRD/Story). Produces story-by-story KPI reports, metric-vs-target comparisons, gap analysis with root causes, and linked improvement suggestions.
howto.when_en: Activated when delivery is complete, runtime data is available, and success metrics were defined in PRD or Story.

say_en.text: Evaluate the newly delivered user story against performance targets.
say_en.note: Generates a KPI report and gap analysis.

say_en.text: Check if this delivery meets the defined success metrics.
say_en.note: Compares actual vs target, suggests improvements.

say_en.text: Analyze if runtime data of this feature meets expectations.
